title: Steinecke
description: steinecke.de Steinecke is a German family bakery group founded in 1945, based in Mariental, Lower Saxony, and run by the third and fourth generation Katrin and Felix Steinecke. It has 500+ branches in six states, three plants (Mariental, Berlin, Bernburg), about 3700 staff and 223 million euro revenue (2024), Germany's largest family owned bakery. Formats include own shops, in store bakeries in REWE, Netto and Marktkauf, railway and cafe sites under Brotmeisterei Steinecke, Ihr Bäcker and Heidebrot Backstube. Around 30 breads, rolls, cakes, snacks and coffee are sold, led by Hausbrot and Heidebrot from an 80 year old sourdough with 24 hour dough rest, baked on stone at nearly 400 degrees. It earned 39 straight DLG quality awards and topped the 2026 German Customer Award. It buys Bio and Fairtrade, uses green power, offsets CO2 and follows supply chain human rights rules. A cyberattack on 15 November 2026 hit its IT, but shops and production kept running.
